data.name: Dharambir
data.gender_notes: Dharambir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dharambir is derived from Sanskrit, where 'Dharam' means duty, righteousness, and 'Bir' means brave, hero. This name represents a courageous individual who is committed to his dharma, or duty, and upholds the moral and ethical values of society. The name Dharambir carries the meaning “Dharma (duty) + Bir (brave, hero)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharambir usually hope their child will grow to embody dharma (duty) + bir (brave, hero) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace your duty with courage and integrity.
data.etymology: Dharambir belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dharma (duty) + Bir (brave, hero).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharambir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
